verdict.rationale: Better Stack's own marketing pages repeatedly state that it ships an official MCP server for bringing logs, metrics, traces, web events and errors into LLM workflows. They also explicitly mention using it inside Claude Code, so an agent can connect via a first-party MCP server. The evidence is marketing copy only, which is why quality is held at 7 and confidence at medium. Missing for 10: setup/connection documentation (endpoint, auth flow, client configuration), a list of exposed tools or capabilities, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as claimed.
